description: Quantum's journal class quantumarticle v6.1 (2022/11/08, CTAN and MiKTeX package quantumarticle, LPPL 1.3c), built on article. Options as the journal's template (quantum-template.tex: a4paper,twocolumn,11pt) without its accepted=<date> key, which prints an 'Accepted in Quantum' box for accepted papers; twocolumn is also the class default. a4paper is needed: without a paper size the class stops with a ClassError (quantumarticle.cls l.236-245). nopdfoutputerror is needed under XeTeX: without it the class ends with \pdfoutput=0 (l.1558), a pdfTeX primitive XeTeX lacks ('Undefined control sequence' in every document), and wraps \usepackage to stop when \pdfoutput=1 is missing (l.256-272); the option skips only those two checks. The class loads geometry and fancyhdr itself and silently skips a later \usepackage of geometry, fancyhdr, titlesec or authblk. It stops with a ClassError on a \usepackage of a font package (times, mathptmx, lmodern, newtx and others, l.1514-1556), on \today (an arXiv guard, l.296-308; allowtoday makes it a warning) and on font commands in \title. At \begin{document} it loads lmodern, which under XeTeX selects the TU Latin Modern fonts. General's \usepackage{lmodern} is left out (omitPreamble): the class's font blacklist stops on it (l.1540) and loads lmodern itself. The preamble takes revtex4-2-aps.json's \@mkpream@relax line: in two columns the class uses ltxutil's \switch@array, and p-column tables stop with "Extra \or" without it (batch 2 probe). The first preamble line loads nameref, so its begindocument sorting rule is set before the class loads hyperref inside \AtBeginDocument (l.1392-1394); without it most documents stopped at "Sorting rule for 'begindocument' hook applied too late" (first batch 2 run; probe B2PROF-quantum-nameref). Two more lines from the footnote errors that nameref exposed (round b27: \vadjust in \make@footnotetext 2,137 branches, \@makefntext 1,740): revtex4-2-aps.json's \make@footnotetext, whose \vadjust is guarded by \ifhmode for the footnotes footnotehyper sets at the end of an environment, and the class's \@makefntext redefined as \long (probe run 41965875569: 5 errors without them, 1 with the \long line alone, 0 with both). \title gives the class the title its \maketitle requires ("No \title given" in documents without a title way; fix session's probe: 4 errors before, 0 after). The option allowfontchangeintitle lets a title carry font commands, which quantumarticle otherwise stops on with a ClassError (probe B2B-qa-titlefont-new: 68 errors to 0). The redefined float end puts the float out through \vadjust when it ends in horizontal mode, and directly in vertical mode (probe B2B-qa-vadjust-new: 4 errors to 0, the same 7 pages).
